signal.tail_gate: same_sign_as_oof AND ci_overlaps_oof; days_with_names >= min_trading_days - horizon
signal.tail_cost_report: mean and HAC CI net of one round-trip cost (2 * commission + tax) per tail are reported, not gated (Wei 10/29); the after-cost gate is net_excess
signal.realized_rule: a signal day counts when the holiday-KV calendar shows >= horizon trading days after it up to as_of

net_excess.cost_source: trading:config.fees (2 * commission + tax per unit of one-way turnover)

freshness: as_of is the latest trading day on or before the Taiwan date of generated_at

calendar.note: TWSE published market closures covering the gate window; filled from the TWSE announcement when Wei freezes this policy. Evidence may only add ad hoc closures (e.g. typhoon) that Wei confirmed one by one.
